sharesafe.title: ShareSafe: Metadata Remover
sharesafe.shortDescription: Remove photo metadata on-device. Keep originals. Optional Pro editing.
sharesafe.fullDescription:
Remove location, camera and timestamp metadata from photos before you share them. ShareSafe creates fresh JPEG copies on your device while keeping your originals untouched.

FREE PHOTO CLEANING + PRIVACY CHECK
- Check selected EXIF location, date/time and camera/device fields before cleaning
- Create fresh JPEG copies without the original embedded metadata
- Check exported copies again for the selected fields
- Replace original filenames with neutral filenames
- Choose JPEG quality, export individual photos or one ZIP, and save to your gallery

Privacy Check reports readable field presence, not a guarantee of anonymity. Android or your file provider may hide metadata. Unsupported or unreadable checks are marked unknown, not safe.

OPTIONAL SHARESAFE PRO — ONE-TIME PURCHASE
Advanced Edit adds privacy tools for one photo at a time:
- Face Assist finds possible faces on-device using a bundled model, without a model download
- Review suggestions and apply selected solid covers, or dismiss them
- Add manual solid Cover areas for private text, names, addresses, IDs, faces or number plates
- Select, move, resize, edit numerically or delete individual areas
- Optional blur and pixelation, zoom, pan, undo and redo
- Export a flattened JPEG copy

Face Assist detects possible faces, not identities. It can miss faces or suggest the wrong area. It does not automatically detect text, IDs or number plates. Always review the result.

Metadata cleaning and Privacy Check stay free. Pro is a permanent one-time Google Play purchase, with no subscription. Your local price is shown before purchase. Existing Pro owners receive the new Pro tools. Use Restore Pro purchase with the Google Play account that bought Pro.

ON-DEVICE PHOTO PROCESSING
Photo cleaning, editing and face detection happen on your device. ShareSafe does not upload photos or detection results to Kreativ or Google. There are no ads and no ShareSafe account. Google Play handles optional purchases.

The Play edition includes Google ML Kit, which collects device/app information, per-installation identifiers, performance/error metrics and feature usage/configuration information. These SDK metrics are separate from photo content. See the privacy policy for details.

IMPORTANT PRIVACY DETAILS
Removing metadata does not hide information visible inside an image. Review every exported copy before sharing. Blur and pixelation may still reveal information; use solid Cover for sensitive details.

Copies are JPEGs, not identical backups. Large images may be resized, transparency becomes white and animated inputs export one frame. Originals are not changed.

STEP-BY-STEP GUIDE
Learn how to check metadata, clean a copy and share it:
https://madebykreativ.com/news/remove-photo-metadata-android-sharesafe/

Privacy policy: https://madebykreativ.com/privacy/sharesafe/
Support: info@madebykreativ.com

northlight.title: Northlight: Offline Compass
northlight.shortDescription: Offline compass, spoken headings, GPS altitude and lights. Optional paid Pro.
northlight.fullDescription:
Find your bearing with Northlight, an offline magnetic compass for Android with optional spoken headings, GPS altitude estimates and useful light tools.

Read a heading, hear the direction your phone is facing, check an approximate altitude or open a red screen light. The core tools are free, with no ads or account.

FREE COMPASS AND SPOKEN HEADINGS
- Large magnetic compass with degrees and direction inside the dial
- Sensor accuracy feedback and figure-eight calibration guidance
- Speak one heading or enable optional automatic announcements
- Installed offline English or Romanian voices, with speed and interval controls
- Screen-reader handoff when active

OPTIONAL GPS ALTIMETER
- Altitude estimates in metres or feet
- Shows the altitude reference and reported vertical uncertainty when available
- Starts only when enabled with precise foreground location permission
- Stops when you leave the home screen or lock your phone; never restarts on its own

LIGHT TOOLS
- Camera LED lantern, with brightness control on supported phones
- Adjustable red screen light
- Repeating SOS flash signal
- Quick Settings lantern tile

OPTIONAL NORTHLIGHT PRO — ONE-TIME PURCHASE
- Save up to eight named magnetic bearings on this device
- Open saved bearings from the home screen; follow, rename or delete them
- Optional spoken phone-turn guidance and alignment haptic feedback
- Amber and green screen lights, plus an adjustable flash strobe
- Restore ownership using the same Google Play account; no subscription

Compass, spoken headings, GPS altitude, lantern, red light and SOS stay free. Features depend on your phone's sensors, camera flash, Android settings and permissions. Your local Pro price is shown before purchase.

ON-DEVICE TOOLS
No account, ads, analytics or tracking. Camera access is requested for flash tools only; Northlight does not take photos or record video. Location is optional and used only for the altimeter. Coordinates, routes and altitude history are not saved or uploaded. No microphone or audio recording is used.

Compass and light tools work offline. Speech needs an installed offline voice; installing voices may require internet access. With a screen reader active, its own voice and privacy settings apply. GPS needs usable satellite reception. Google Play uses internet access for purchases and ownership checks. Website links open your browser only when tapped.

IMPORTANT LIMITATIONS
The compass shows magnetic north, not true north. Metal, magnets and cases can affect it. GPS altitude is an estimate: read its reference and uncertainty. WGS84 height is not sea level or height above ground. Spoken and saved-bearing cues describe phone orientation, not walking direction, routes, obstacles or arrival. SOS is a flashing light, not an emergency call. Northlight is not for safety-critical navigation or a substitute for emergency communications. Use flashing lights with care around people sensitive to flashes.

Privacy: https://madebykreativ.com/privacy/northlight/
Support: info@madebykreativ.com

paperbuild.title: PaperBuild: Photo to PDF
paperbuild.shortDescription: Photos to PDF offline, with cropping, page styles and an on-device PDF library
paperbuild.fullDescription:
Turn photos into a PDF on your Android phone. PaperBuild lets you capture a page with your camera app or choose images, arrange them, crop the edges and export one document. Processing happens on your device, without an account or ads.

FREE PHOTO TO PDF TOOLS
- Add images with Android's system picker or open your camera app to capture a page
- Build documents with up to 10 pages
- Preview, reorder, rotate and remove pages
- Crop manually without changing the original; restore the full page when needed
- Choose A4 or US Letter and colour, grayscale or high-contrast page treatment
- Resume your privately saved draft after closing the app
- Open, share or save the finished PDF to Downloads/PaperBuild

FIND YOUR RECENT PDFS
Completed documents are saved in a private on-device library. Preview unprotected PDFs, rename them, open or share a copy, or save to Downloads. Move a document to Removed PDFs when you no longer need it; restore it or confirm permanent deletion later. Exported copies stay untouched.

OPTIONAL PAPERBUILD PRO — ONE-TIME PURCHASE
- Smaller PDF exports
- More than the free 10-page limit
- Merge PDFs or extract a page or page range
- Password-protect exported PDFs
- Add custom text watermarks and page numbers
- Save named export presets; passwords are never saved

Pro is a permanent unlock, not a subscription. Your local Google Play price is shown before purchase. Restore ownership using the same Google Play account. The photo-to-PDF workflow, cropping and Recent PDFs remain free.

ON-DEVICE PROCESSING
PaperBuild has no account, advertising, analytics, tracking or internet permission. It does not upload your images or documents. Google Play handles connectivity for purchases and ownership checks. Android's image picker and camera app let you choose the pages; PaperBuild does not request broad gallery access or direct camera permission. Android 8 and 9 may require storage permission when saving to Downloads.

When you open or share a PDF, the receiving app handles that copy under its own privacy terms. Keep important copies outside PaperBuild before uninstalling: uninstalling removes the private draft and Recent PDFs library. Saved Downloads are not removed by the app.

BEFORE YOU EXPORT
This is an image-to-PDF maker, not OCR, automatic edge detection or a PDF text editor. Review page order, cropping and readability before sharing. Smaller exports and page treatments can change image quality. PDF merge and extraction retain page content and sizes rather than rasterising pages. Password-protected input PDFs are not supported; use an unlocked copy. Editing invalidates digital signatures; extracted PDFs discard bookmarks and page labels. Watermarks and page numbers are not redaction or digital signatures.

Output passwords protect exported PDFs, not source images or draft working files. Passwords are not saved in drafts or presets, and forgotten passwords cannot be recovered.

Step-by-step tutorial: https://madebykreativ.com/news/photos-to-pdf-android-paperbuild/

Privacy: https://github.com/aolaru/kreativ-mobile-apps/blob/main/paperbuild/PRIVACY_POLICY.md
Support: info@madebykreativ.com

kreativ-font.title: Kreativ Font: Font Discovery
kreativ-font.shortDescription: Search fonts, zoom previews and save favourites. Not a phone-font installer.
kreativ-font.fullDescription:
Find typefaces for your next design project with Kreativ Font, the free Android companion to kreativfont.com. Browse commercial and free font articles, inspect website preview artwork and keep a shortlist of favourites.

This is a font-discovery app, not a font installer or text editor. It does not change your phone's system font, create lettering or install fonts into other apps. The app is free; linked fonts have their own prices and licence terms.

BROWSE AND SEARCH
- Explore separate Commercial Fonts and Free Fonts sections
- Start with 10 recent articles in each section and use Load 10 more to continue
- Search the full website font catalogue, not just the articles already loaded
- Filter online results with All, Commercial or Free
- Load more search results in batches of up to 10 unique fonts
- Refresh the latest sections to check for newly published articles

INSPECT THE PREVIEW
Tap a preview image to open the website artwork full-screen. Pinch to zoom, drag to pan or double-tap to zoom or reset. Zoom in, Zoom out and Fit controls are also available. These are existing preview images, not a live type tester: you cannot enter your own text. Tap a font title to read its description, or View font to open its original article in your browser.

KEEP A SHORTLIST
Tap a bookmark to save a font to Favorites without creating an account. Saved entries retain their description and article link after they leave the latest feed. Search saved favourites locally on your device, and remove bookmarks when you no longer need them.

Favourites are stored only on this device. Clearing app storage or uninstalling removes them; there is no cloud sync or account-based recovery. Previously loaded article information can be viewed offline, but preview images depend on the local cache.

KNOW WHAT YOU ARE OPENING
An internet connection is needed for current articles, online catalogue search and opening websites. Catalogue search sends your phrase to kreativfont.com; request URLs may appear in hosting logs. Avoid personal or sensitive details in searches. Searching saved favourites stays local.

The native app has no advertising or analytics SDKs and does not request camera, photo-library, contact or location access. Website requests still involve hosting/CDN request data. Browser visits follow the destination website's own privacy, cookie and affiliate terms.

Font downloads, prices and licences are handled by the linked websites, not inside the app. A Free label is not a promise of unrestricted commercial use. Read the publisher's licence for each font and intended use. The app interface and website articles are in English.

Step-by-step tutorial: https://madebykreativ.com/news/discover-fonts-android-kreativ-font/

Android app privacy: https://kreativfont.com/blog/terms-of-use-privacy-policy#android-app-privacy
Support: contact@kreativfont.com

kreativ-fancy-text.title: Kreativ Fancy Text
kreativ-fancy-text.shortDescription: Create fancy Unicode text and PNG designs. Style words and work offline.
kreativ-fancy-text.fullDescription:
Make your words feel like you.

Kreativ Fancy Text turns a short thought, name or message into copyable Unicode text and matching PNG artwork. Create on your device, without an account, advertising or an internet connection.

STYLE THE WHOLE MESSAGE OR ONE WORD
Explore 17 text styles, including bold, italic, script, gothic, monospace, bubble and small caps. Tap a word to give it a different text style or image color. Undo and redo edits while you work.

CHOOSE A LOOK
Start with six coordinated themes: The original, Lilac daydream, After hours, Love notes, Ink & paper and Golden hour. Adjust text size and alignment, and add an optional signature to your image.

COPY TEXT OR SAVE AN IMAGE
Copy styled Unicode text or open Android's share sheet. Export PNG artwork as a square, portrait or story, at standard or 2x resolution. Choose an optional transparent background. Save PNG opens Android's file picker so you choose the destination.

KEEP DESIGNS ON YOUR DEVICE
Your current draft restores when you reopen the app. Save up to 50 complete designs, reopen them and continue editing. Deleted saved designs can be recovered during the current app session. Edit history and deletion recovery are not backups.

OFFLINE AND AD-FREE
Fonts and assets are bundled. The Android app has no account, advertising or analytics SDK, cloud sync or internet permission. It does not install phone fonts or a keyboard and does not request accessibility service access.

KNOW WHAT YOU ARE SHARING
Copy text keeps Unicode characters, not image colors, decorations or the bundled image font. Appearance and character support depend on the receiving app and its fonts. Unsupported letters remain in their original form. Use PNG when you want to preserve the visual design.

Input supports up to 1,200 UTF-16 code units; some characters use more than one. Long messages shrink to fit the image. If a message still cannot fit, export is blocked with an explanation: shorten it, remove line breaks or choose a taller format.

Drafts and saved designs are local to this installation. Clearing storage or uninstalling removes them. Exported or shared copies stay where you put them. Sharing to another app is your choice and follows that app's policies.

Privacy: https://madebykreativ.com/privacy/kreativ-fancy-text/
Support: info@madebykreativ.com

photofeather.title: PhotoFeather: Photo Compressor
photofeather.shortDescription: Compress and resize photos on your device for forms, email and sharing
photofeather.fullDescription:
Lighter photos. Ready to share.

PhotoFeather by Made by Kreativ helps you make photos smaller for upload forms, email and messaging. Select your photos, choose a file-size target or resize setting, preview the measured results, then save new copies or share them.

CHOOSE A FILE-SIZE TARGET
Try 200 KB, 500 KB, 1 MB or a custom maximum. PhotoFeather adjusts JPEG quality and, when needed, resolution within its processing limits. Results show the actual encoded file size. If a target cannot be met, the app explains it and does not offer that unsuccessful result for export.

RESIZE WITH CLEAR DIMENSIONS
Choose Small (1280 px), Medium (1920 px), Large (2560 px) or a custom longest edge from 64 to 8192 pixels. Aspect ratio is preserved and smaller photos are never enlarged. Planned width and height appear before processing; results show the final dimensions. Use resize-only mode when you do not need a file-size target.

CHECK BEFORE YOU SAVE
Compare original and output sizes, dimensions and percentage saved. Zoom and pan in the before-and-after view. Optional advanced JPEG quality controls let you set a quality limit. Large photos may be reduced to fit the app's memory limit, and a file-size target may reduce dimensions further.

WORK WITH ONE PHOTO OR A BATCH
Select multiple photos, follow progress, cancel processing and review per-photo results. Retry failed items or export selected successful copies. Unsupported or unreadable files are identified individually. Larger or same-sized results require your explicit choice before export.

KEEP YOUR ORIGINALS
PhotoFeather saves new JPEG copies and never overwrites or deletes originals. Share copies through Android's share sheet. Transparent PNG and WebP images need an opaque background for JPEG output; choose the background before converting.

ON-DEVICE PROCESSING
No accounts, photo uploads, advertising SDKs, analytics SDKs or subscriptions. PhotoFeather has no internet permission. Android's system picker may retrieve photos from a cloud provider you choose; the provider handles that retrieval.

METADATA REMOVED FROM COPIES
Source metadata, including embedded location metadata, is removed from newly encoded JPEG copies and checked before export. This does not anonymise photos or remove faces, text or sensitive details visible in the image.

SUPPORTED FORMATS AND LIMITS
Inputs: JPEG, PNG and static WebP. Output: lossy JPEG. HEIC/HEIF, AVIF, GIF and animated images are not supported. JPEG compression can reduce visible quality; lossless compression and guaranteed visual quality are not promised. File-size units are decimal: 1 KB = 1000 bytes and 1 MB = 1000000 bytes.

Supports dark mode, large text and labelled accessibility controls. All features described here are included in version 1.0.0, with no purchases.

Support: info@madebykreativ.com
